findings.current: Unlike Cheongpung, who had been born a bug, he became an earthworm
findings.defect: The draft makes Cheongpung the one born a bug. The source says Jin Taekyung was born a bug, unlike Cheongpung.
findings.rationale: 태생부터 버러지였던 놈 refers to Jin Taekyung.
findings.replacement: Unlike Cheongpung, Jin Taekyung had been born a bug. Then he became an earthworm
findings.source: 청풍과는 달리 태생부터 버러지였던 놈이 지렁이가 되더니

findings.current:
Just a month ago, one had even shaken an entire province.

No—more precisely, it had *almost* shaken one.
findings.defect: 성(城) is a city here, not a province; the draft changes the scale of the near-disaster.
findings.rationale: The 城 character specifies a city, and the following sentence retracts the claim that it was actually shaken.
findings.replacement:
Just a month ago, one had even shaken an entire city.

No—more precisely, it had *almost* shaken one.
findings.source:
불과 한 달 전에는 한 성(城)을 뒤흔들었던 적도 있었다.

아니, 정확히는 뒤흔들 ‘뻔’했었다.

findings.current: Even the martial arts of demonic, heterodox arts, which were mastered far faster than orthodox techniques, were no exception.
findings.defect: “Martial arts of demonic, heterodox arts” is redundant and ungrammatical.
findings.rationale: 사마외도의 무공 refers to heterodox martial arts themselves.
findings.replacement: Even demonic, heterodox martial arts, which could be mastered far faster than orthodox techniques, were no exception.
findings.source: 사마외도(邪魔外道)의 무공도 예외는 아니었다.

findings.current: The less pure and profound the martial arts, the countless more people who faltered before the Peak realm.
findings.defect: The English comparative is grammatically incomplete and obscures the point.
findings.rationale: The source links the arts’ lack of purity and depth to the countless practitioners unable to cross into the Peak realm.
findings.replacement: With martial arts that lacked purity and depth, countless people faltered before the wall of the Peak realm.
findings.source: 무공의 정순함과 깊이가 떨어지는 만큼, 절정의 벽 앞에서 좌절하는 이들의 숫자는 셀 수도 없이 많았다.

summary: Two scene facts are changed; two passages need localized correction.
